verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own docs say composition functions can be written in Go and Python as well as YAML and KCL, which implies first-party programmatic language support for building against the product. However, no evidence names or documents an official SDK, its API surface, or its language coverage; the CLI evidence belongs to a different story and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs (e.g. Go/Python function SDKs), SDK reference docs and versioning, any client SDK for the Crossplane APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with them.
